meta.name: RPSGT Scoring Lab Phase 3 event-boundary pack
meta.sourceBasis: Original Sleep Pathways Guild teaching signals created to practice continuous respiratory-event placement and counting across 30-second display boundaries.
meta.clinicalBoundary: Epoch boundaries organize the display; they do not divide one continuous physiologic event into separate events. These cases teach event continuity and placement only and do not reproduce proprietary scoring-rule text or establish clinical competency.

cases.title: One event across the first boundary
cases.prompt: Count the physiologic respiratory events, then mark the event that continues from Epoch 1 into Epoch 2.
cases.focus: The 30-second divider crosses the event, but the underlying reduction remains continuous.
cases.rationale: The airflow reduction begins before 0:30 and recovers after 0:30 without returning to baseline at the divider. It is one continuous physiologic event even though the display changes epochs.

cases.title: Two events with one crossing 1:00
cases.prompt: Count all physiologic respiratory events, then mark the event that crosses from Epoch 2 into Epoch 3.
cases.focus: Separate events are divided by a clear return toward baseline; an epoch divider alone is not a separator.
cases.rationale: There are two distinct reductions because airflow recovers between them. The second begins before 1:00 and continues after 1:00, so that boundary-crossing reduction is still one event.

cases.title: Boundary event followed by a separate event
cases.prompt: Count the physiologic respiratory events, then mark the event that crosses the 0:30 boundary.
cases.focus: Use recovery of the physiologic signal—not the epoch label—to decide where one event ends and another can begin.
cases.rationale: The first reduction remains continuous through 0:30 and recovers near 0:43. A separate later reduction begins after a substantial return toward baseline, producing two events total.

cases.title: Three events with a middle boundary crossing
cases.prompt: Count all physiologic respiratory events, then mark the middle event that continues across the 1:00 boundary.
cases.focus: Track onset, continuity, and recovery through all three epochs before deciding the count.
cases.rationale: Three reductions are separated by clear recovery. The middle reduction crosses 1:00 without recovering at the divider, so it remains one event rather than becoming two.
